title: Reaching Coldpass/Marrowgate required 'the Keeper's Key', obtainable only from an NPC (Keeper Wren) in a third, distant hold (Hollowbrook/Barrowmere) that nothing in the main quest text pointed to. The quest line read 'The Keepers can open the pilgrim stair at Coldpass, north past Wardmoor,' which reads as a literal direction (walk north from Wardmoor) rather than 'go find a specific Keeper elsewhere and get a key first.' I only found this by chance while chasing a companion's unrelated sidequest.
